target.title: fix(agents): prevent duplicate subagent recovery after restart
target.body:
Closes #103724

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where a gateway restart could schedule overlapping orphan-recovery scans and resume the same interrupted subagent twice. Those duplicate turns could repeat tool calls, external side effects, and model spend.

## Why This Change Was Made

The recovery scheduler now owns one retry chain at a time and coalesces overlapping requests into one follow-up scan. This preserves recovery requests raised while a scan is active without allowing independent scans to dispatch the same orphan concurrently.

The regression parks the first gateway resume, schedules a second recovery request, and verifies that only one resume is dispatched before the first completes and that the queued follow-up observes the cleared restart marker.

## User Impact

Interrupted subagents are resumed at most once across overlapping restart-time recovery triggers, avoiding duplicate work and side effects while retaining a follow-up pass for newly discovered orphaned work.

## Evidence

Negative control against unchanged `origin/main` production code:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/subagent-orphan-recovery.test.ts -- -t "coalesces overlapping scheduled recovery into one follow-up scan" --reporter=verbose

FAIL: expected callGateway to be called once, but got 2 times
```

After the fix:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/subagent-orphan-recovery.test.ts src/agents/subagent-registry.steer-restart.test.ts -- --reporter=verbose

Test Files  2 passed (2)
Tests       44 passed (44)
```

Additional checks:

- `oxfmt --check` on both changed files: passed
- targeted `oxlint` on both changed files: passed
- `git diff --check`: passed
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local`: clean; no accepted/actionable findings

Blacksmith Testbox pre-warm was attempted, but the configured Crabbox binary failed its local `--version`/`--help` sanity check before allocating a remote box. The focused bundled-Node local fallback above was used instead.

AI-assisted: Codex implemented and reviewed this change. I understand the lifecycle serialization, queued follow-up behavior, retry/finalization path, and regression proof.
